baseline.expressionBackend: Independent JS interpreter, identical for baseline and optimized runs
baseline.scope: Headless fixed-tick CPU simulation of authored synthetic loads, including CNS, contact scanning and cleanup. No graphics, archive loading or audio; no browser or phone FPS claim.

optimized.expressionBackend: Independent JS interpreter, identical for baseline and optimized runs
optimized.scope: Headless fixed-tick CPU simulation of authored synthetic loads, including CNS, contact scanning and cleanup. No graphics, archive loading or audio; no browser or phone FPS claim.

combatBenchmark.scope: Sequential host samples of authored stationary synthetic loads. Identical checksums; no graphics/audio/imports, phone FPS or full-engine comparison. A final source change to handle positive wall offsets required rerunning the optimized measurement; these are the final-source results.

reference.method: Unmodified official Linux executable with authored CNS VarSet probes; fractional inside/outside positions, both facings, Width edge changes, 320/1280 coordinates. Samples are CNS reads before movement/clamping.

edgeTriggerProbes.scope: 480 exact CNS trigger reads from 120 observations: both facings, fractional inside/outside positions, standing/airborne, Width changes, localcoord widths 320 and 1280, fixed camera at zoom 1.

reference.method: Unmodified official Linux executable, original KFM data and authored QA AssertInput recipe for kfm-100-0-1-near. Authored -3 controllers sample velocity, threshold and state time before the common state runs. The second run injects x velocity 10 at idle time 1. No native implementation source was read.

idleStopProbes.scope: Default standing idle with no direction held, ground friction .85 and threshold 2, localcoord 320. Does not establish other common-state or physics profiles.
